text: Qualified the nonlinear implementation across platforms and affected consumers. Flashalign passed 144/144 JVM tests, 143/143 Scala.js FastOpt tests and 143/143 Scala.js FullOpt tests. The nonlinear coverage includes map/JVP/VJP adjoints, matrix-free patch products, Gale PCG and pose elimination, PE direction/gauge/prior/certificate/bracketed inverse/recovery, small-strain gauge/elastic prior/global bound/contraction inverse/recovery, data-only model selection, persistent records and bounded one-pass output. Static capability audit found no asInstanceOf/@unchecked or filesystem/thread types in the eleven nonlinear implementation files; public nonlinear records contain immutable vectors, while arrays/workspaces remain private, frame owners are checked, complete nonlinear matrix export is rejected and numerical inverse evidence is never promoted to SmoothIso. PRD/build graph/symbol checks passed (148 IDs, 28 nodes, 95 edges, 1394 unique public names). Generated JVM/JS POMs contain only the intended core/Lie/register/resample/multiscale/spectral and Gale/image4s/Ravel dependencies; no NIfTI, motion, HalfFlow, laws or JMH runtime edge; default bundles still exclude Flashalign. Affected consumers all passed: Lie 12/12 each, register 4/4 each, resample 13 JVM/11 JS, multiscale 10 each, spectral 6 each, motion 42 JVM/39 JS, HalfFlow 143 JVM/140 JS; HalfFlow defaults and independent experimental state were unchanged. This is engineering/platform admission only; external nonlinear accuracy and comparison claims remain separate.
